evidence_scope: source and contract inspection only; this branch does not publish or run a rebuilt play.oldkoweb.com bundle

checks.evidence: P2-10 patch does not alter camera equations, mouse deltas, renderer or viewport math.
checks.blocker: Fresh P2-00 browser bundle and real pointer/camera run required.

checks.evidence: No turn bindings are replaced by the P2-10 patch.
checks.blocker: Real-browser input replay required after rebuild.

checks.evidence: Source patch sets engine focus false, deactivates input, calls KeyboardClearInput() and MouseRemoveFlag(); static contract test asserts all four invariants.

checks.evidence: Source patch restores engine focus and SetActiveDevices(TRUE).
Native SDL key-down path toggles SDL fullscreen only on ALT+RETURN, i.e. inside a physical user gesture.
checks.runtime_followup: Browser permission/fullscreen transition must be observed after P2-00 rebuild.

checks.evidence: P2-10 does not swallow ESC or introduce an HTML exit control.

checks.runtime_followup: Real browser should type W/A/S/D into chat while verifying no movement packets.

checks.evidence: P2-10 retains native CUIManager/CGameProcMain mouse path and adds no DOM overlay.
checks.blocker: P2-03 viewport-to-game contract is missing and a rebuilt browser run is required.

checks.evidence: No coordinate transform was duplicated in P2-10.
checks.blocker: P2-03 handoff absent; P2-10 will consume its single adapter once published.

checks.evidence: Town/battle BGM and teardown are source-proven native CN3SndObj paths; no DOM audio graph was added.
checks.blocker: WS42 single-thread browser patch deliberately disables sound initialization; audio-capable P2-00 rebuild not yet proven.

checks.evidence: P2-10 keeps native Option/CN3SndMgr ownership and ReleaseSound teardown.
checks.blocker: Cannot prove persistence or no duplicate playback until browser audio is enabled and the client is re-entered twice.

drag a native skill icon to hotbar and invoke its key; confirm cooldown/target/error are server-derived
open NPC dialog/shop/inn/quest/upgrade and prove every success comes from provider response
hold W then lose focus; regain focus with character stationary
type WASD in chat without movement
click native UI over world target without target/move leakage
ALT+ENTER fullscreen, ESC/pointer-lock behavior and camera turn
town/ambient/footstep/attack/skill/UI audio after first gesture; mute/volume; leave/re-enter twice with no doubled sound
